items.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
items.description: The BBC joins Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it regains crucial territory in the Donbas, but optimism has been dampened by souring relations with President Trump.

items.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
items.description: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

items.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack

items.title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress that sparked a huge spy scandal
items.description: For 15 months, a high-security courtroom in Hamburg has been hearing the case of Christina Block, accused of ordering the abduction of her children.

items.title: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
items.description: Speed curbs limited Ukraine's defences against deadly Russian attacks on Tuesday night.

items.title: Pope pictured for first time since surgery and cancer diagnosis

items.title: India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest
items.description: The youth-led movement had called for a Delhi protest after mass detentions last week and the jailing of two leaders.

items.title: Patients in chains rescued from suspected illegal rehab centre in South Africa
items.description: Some of the 200 patients were found with "sores all over their bodies" and in overcrowded rooms.

items.description: Two people were airlifted to hospital but no-one's life appeared to be in danger, officials said.

items.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
